title: How to Book Pind Daan in Gaya — Step-by-Step Booking Guide with Pitraya Rituals
metaDescription: Complete guide to booking your Gaya Pind Daan ceremony — what information you need, how to choose a package, what happens after booking, and how Pitraya coordinates your entire pilgrimage.
author: Pitraya Rituals Concierge Team
keywords: how to book Pind Daan Gaya
summary: Booking a Gaya Pind Daan ceremony through Pitraya Rituals is a simple 5-step process. This guide walks you through everything from selecting a package to arriving at Vishnupad Temple on ceremony day.
content:
Booking an authentic Gaya Pind Daan ceremony has historically been a confusing, opaque process. Pitraya Rituals was built to make this as simple as booking a flight. Here is the complete booking process.

### Step 1: Choose Your Package
Visit pitraya.com/packages and select based on:
- Number of Dhaams (3, 16, or 45)
- Number of family members traveling
- Duration (1 day, 2 days, or full pilgrimage)
- Accommodation preference (budget, standard, or luxury)

### Step 2: Provide Ancestor Details
After selecting a package, you will fill out a secure form providing:
- Your full name and mobile number
- Ancestor's full name (Sanskrit/Hindi)
- Ancestor's gotra (lineage clan name)
- Date of death (or approximate year)
- Relationship to the ancestor
- Your ancestral home state and district

### Step 3: Receive Confirmation & Coordinator Assignment
Within 24 hours, you receive:
- Booking confirmation with reservation ID
- Assigned Gayawal Purohit details (name, registration number, lineage)
- WhatsApp connection with your Pitraya coordinator
- Travel preparation checklist

### Step 4: Pre-Ceremony Coordination
Your coordinator contacts you 48 hours before arrival to confirm:
- Arrival time at Gaya airport or station
- Hotel check-in schedule
- Ceremony day timeline
- Any special requirements or health accommodations

### Step 5: Ceremony Day Execution
On ceremony day, your private vehicle picks you up from the hotel. The Gayawal Purohit meets you at Vishnupad Ghat. All samagri is pre-prepared. You participate in your ancestral ceremony with full guidance.

sections.heading: What Information Must I Have Ready Before Booking?
sections.body: Essential: Ancestor's name and approximate death date, your gotra name (family lineage clan — if unknown, our coordinators help determine this), and your ancestral home state. Optional but recommended: ancestor's photograph, specific death tithi (Hindu lunar date), and list of all ancestors to be included in the Sankalp.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book for Pitru Paksha?
faqs.answer: For Pitru Paksha (the most auspicious 16-day period), we recommend booking at least 3-4 months in advance. Hotels within 1km of Vishnupad Temple and verified Gayawal Purohit slots fill up by June for the October season.

faqs.question: Can I book for a specific date and time?
faqs.answer: Yes. When booking, you specify your preferred ceremony dates. For Pitru Paksha, the ceremony is ideally performed on the tithi (lunar date) corresponding to your ancestor's death anniversary. Your coordinator confirms the astrologically optimal timing.
